items.name: Friend of the Muster's Ring
items.lore: Four little knots, one for each hall of the Muster.

items.name: Muster-Marcher's Belt
items.lore: A marching belt with a turf-spade, a sentinel's spear, a druid's sickle and a keener's comb on the buckle.

items.name: Spear of the South Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with a spearhead clasp pointing south.

items.name: Four Halls Bracer
items.lore: Carved with the Ceannai tower, Aine's stones, Alainn Bin's walls and the Keeners' comb.

items.name: Mantle of the Lightbreaker
items.lore: Night-dark. Only a Lightbreaker wears it.
